title: Yoga with Picasso | Yoga with Sabrina Feliu
location:
Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein (Lageplan)
Städtle 32
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
An event organized by the Hilti Art Foundation.

«My passion is to create connections – be it through words, encounters or shared practice on the yoga mat. Movement helps me sort myself out and connect with myself. Yoga accompanies me as my 'safe space', which keeps me in balance between all the ups and downs of life and gives me orientation when I don't know where to go. Again and again it is the ground on which I come to a standstill.
My yoga classes are powerful and flowing, with plenty of space so you can connect with yourself. In my lessons I not only want to impart knowledge, but also bring a feeling of light and lightness into your life. I look forward to accompanying you on your yoga path. Namaste.” – Sabrina Feliu

Yoga with Picasso
Since 2019, the Hilti Art Foundation has been inviting visitors to museum experiences of a special kind: from yoga to chanting, from Qi-Gong to breathing exercises - an experience for body and mind in the midst of great art. 10 minutes introduction with a work of art.

To end the day, delicious snacks and healthy refreshments will be served afterwards.

time
6 p.m. to 7 p.m. (or 8 p.m.)

Costs
CHF 25 per person, including meals


The number of participants is limited, we ask that you register.

title: Active together | An afternoon at the art museum
location:
Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein (Lageplan)
Städtle 32
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
to the exhibition Eleanor Antin. A retrospective
with Beate Frommelt

We take a close look at individual works of art in the current exhibitions and discuss them. Together with the artist Beate Frommelt, the participants then become active in the studio themselves. We try something different at every appointment.

No previous knowledge is required. Anyone and everyone is welcome! We are open to all ages from the age of 14 and up to a maximum of 10 people.

Beate Frommelt is experienced in working with young people, adults and people suffering from dementia.


time
2 p.m. to 4:30 p.m

As part of the free Wednesday, the offer is free of charge.


The events take place in collaboration with “Zemma tua – Seniors active together”. This program is coordinated by Dementia Liechtenstein.

The number of participants is limited, we ask you to register on +423 235 03 00 or directly via the website.

title: “Live at 11” with “Di klinna Zwei”
description:
Di klinna Zwei – these are the siblings Christel and Clemens Kaufmann, a duo who enjoy handmade, largely acoustic music.

Their repertoire spans Europe and combines folk traditions from different regions, klezmer melodies, Balkan rhythms, songs by Swiss songwriters and sounds from Salento. A musical mosaic is created.

Authentic and close to the audience, the two invite you to a varied, musical journey across borders.

The concert takes place in the old parish stables.
Duration: approx. 1 hour
Free collection

We look forward to your coming!
Balzers Cultural Commission

title: Tarkabarka traveling stage in Balzers
description:
Tarkabarka traveling stage in Balzers on the triangle near the community center

Humorous, surprising and touching - that is the company Tarkabarka from Liechtenstein. For 10 years, Anna and Bálint Kostyál-Büchel have been chugging through Switzerland, Liechtenstein, southern Germany, Austria and Hungary with their nostalgic circus wagon team. Her two children and her circus dog Buksi are always there.

The Tarkabarka company delights with expressive theater, fine clowning, fast acrobatics and poetic moments and lets children and adults alike forget time in front of the backdrop of the circus wagon. In her two pieces “KABUFF” and “HOPPAA!!” tell a lot - without words! Come in!

The performances last 60 minutes each and there is a hat collection at the end of the performances. More information at: www.tarkabarka.li
